Choose the one you consider correct and record your choice in soft pencil on the multiple choice answer sheet.  Follow the instructions on the multiple choice answer sheet.  Write in soft pencil.  Write your name, centre number and candidate number on the multiple choice answer sheet in the spaces provided unless this has been done for you.  Do not use correction fluid.  Do not write on any bar codes.  You may use a calculator. questions.questionText: Two identical balls are projected vertically upwards from ground level with the same initial velocity. Ball X is in a vacuum and ball Y is in air. Which statement about the motion of the balls is correct?

options.A: Ball X reaches a greater maximum height and in a longer time than ball Y.
options.B: Ball X reaches a greater maximum height and in a shorter time than ball Y.
options.C: Ball Y reaches a greater maximum height and in a longer time than ball X.
options.D: Ball Y reaches a greater maximum height and in a shorter time than ball X.

questions.questionText: The graph shows the variation of velocity with time for a stone that falls from a bridge into a lake and sinks to the bottom of the lake. velocity 0 time What can be deduced about the motion of the stone?

options.A: Terminal velocity was reached in air.
options.B: The acceleration in air was decreasing with increasing time.
options.C: The distance travelled in water was greater than the distance travelled in air.
options.D: The rate of change of velocity in air was constant.

questions.questionText: The graph shows the variation of the momentum p with time t for a car. p / 104 kg m s–1 0 20 50 60 t / s What is the resultant force on the car at t = 10s?
Which row states whether total momentum and total kinetic energy are conserved in an inelastic collision in which there are no external forces? total momentum total kinetic energy

A tennis ball is thrown vertically upwards. The tennis ball reaches its highest point and then falls back down to the point from which it was thrown. Air resistance is significant. At which position on the path of the tennis ball is the resultant force on the tennis ball greatest?

options.A: at the start just after the tennis ball is released
options.B: when the tennis ball is halfway to its highest point on the way up
options.C: when the tennis ball is at its highest point
options.D: when the tennis ball is halfway from its highest point on the way down

questions.questionText: Which statement correctly describes a couple?

options.A: A couple is a pair of forces that act in the same direction.
options.B: A couple is a pair of forces that act on the centre of gravity of an object.
options.C: A couple is a pair of forces that act to produce a resultant force.
options.D: A couple is a pair of forces that act to produce rotation only.

A stone of mass 0.30kg is thrown vertically downwards with a speed of 20ms–1 from a height of 12m above the ground. It falls vertically until it hits the ground. Air resistance is negligible. What is the kinetic energy of the stone just before it hits the ground?

A student can run or walk up the stairs to her classroom. Which statement describes the power required and the gravitational potential energy gained while running up the stairs compared to walking up them?

options.A: Running provides more gravitational potential energy and uses more power.
options.B: Running provides more gravitational potential energy and uses the same power.
options.C: Running provides the same gravitational potential energy and uses more power.
options.D: Running provides the same gravitational potential energy and uses the same power.

The trolley moves horizontally through a distance p and simultaneously raises the weight through a height q. trolley rail Y r q X weight W p As a result, the weight moves through a distance r from X to Y. It starts and finishes at rest. How much work is done on the weight during this process?

options.A: Wp B W(p + q) C Wq D Wr
